spec2def(twain_32.dll twain_32.spec)

# twain_32.dll is all Rust (twain_32-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/twain_32-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# dsm_ctrl.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/twain_32-rust/src/twain_32/dsm_ctrl.rs)
# twain32_main.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/twain_32-rust/src/twain_32/twain32_main.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(twain_32_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.c)
target_link_libraries(twain_32_shims PRIVATE wine oldnames libuser32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(twain_32_shims)
add_cargo_module(twain_32 twain_32-cargo twain_32.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE twain_32-rust
    DESTINATION reactos
    EXTRA_DEPENDS twain_32_shims psdk)
